title: 13 Best Seafood Restaurants in Hua Hin (2026)

venues.name: Ko Mark Restaurant
venues.nameThai: ร้านอาหารโกหมาก
venues.verdict: The highest-rated seafood restaurant in Hua Hin on Google — a local favorite with phenomenal garlic prawns and curry crab.
venues.whatToOrder: Garlic prawns, curry crab, steamed whole fish with lime. The crab dishes are legendary.
venues.insiderTip: Lunch service and dinner service have a gap — arrive right at 5 PM for dinner to avoid waits.

venues.name: Big Fish & Bar
venues.address: Marriott Resort & Spa, 107/1 Phet Kasem Rd, Hua Hin
venues.verdict: TripAdvisor's #1 rated seafood restaurant in Hua Hin — upscale beachfront dining at the Marriott with exceptional grilled catches.
venues.whatToOrder: The seafood platter for two, grilled tiger prawns, and the catch of the day. Their cocktails are excellent too.
venues.insiderTip: Book a beachside table at sunset for the full experience. The lunch menu is more affordable than dinner.

venues.name: Sea Fire Salt
venues.address: Anantara Hua Hin Resort, 43/1 Phetkasem Beach Rd
venues.verdict: Premium rooftop seafood at the Anantara — Mediterranean-inspired with stunning sea views. The splurge pick.
venues.whatToOrder: Grilled lobster, premium oysters, and the seafood tower. The wine list is one of the best in Hua Hin.
venues.insiderTip: Go for sunset — the rooftop view is spectacular. Reserve ahead on weekends.

venues.name: Fah Muey Restaurant
venues.verdict: A long-standing local seafood institution near the pier — authentic Thai-style seafood with oceanfront views.
venues.whatToOrder: Steamed fish with lime and garlic, stir-fried crab with curry powder, tom yum goong.
venues.insiderTip: Sit by the water for the best views. Portions are generous — order family-style.

venues.name: Chomview Seafood
venues.nameThai: ชมวิวซีฟู้ด
venues.address: 1318/51 Cha-am, Phetchaburi (30 min north of Hua Hin)
venues.verdict: The Reddit-recommended local favorite — only Thais and Chinese tourists eat here. Massive portions, incredible prices.
venues.whatToOrder: The whole grilled fish, garlic prawns, stir-fried morning glory, and crab fried rice.
venues.insiderTip: It's technically in Cha-am (30 min north), but absolutely worth the trip. Arrive before 6 PM on weekends.

venues.name: Coco51 Restaurant & Bar
venues.verdict: Beachfront dining with live music — a great mix of Thai and international seafood in a relaxed atmosphere.
venues.whatToOrder: Seafood BBQ platter, grilled squid, and cocktails while watching the sunset.
venues.insiderTip: Check their Facebook page for live music nights — usually weekends. Beachfront tables go fast.

venues.name: Baan Dum Oceanfront Seafood
venues.verdict: Oceanfront dining on the pier — tables literally over the water. Fresh catches cooked Thai-style with stunning sunset views.
venues.whatToOrder: Whole steamed sea bass, crab meat fried rice, and their signature tom yum soup. The freshness is unmatched.
venues.insiderTip: Request a pier-side table when you arrive. The atmosphere is magical at sunset.

venues.name: Ketsarin Restaurant
venues.verdict: Old town pier-style seafood right on Naresdamri — the classic Hua Hin seafood experience locals actually go to.
venues.whatToOrder: The signature crab curry, steamed fish, and stir-fried prawns with garlic pepper.
venues.insiderTip: Soi Naresdamri is the original Hua Hin fishing pier area — Ketsarin captures that old-school charm.

venues.name: Sailom Hua Hin Restaurant
venues.address: 29 Phet Kasem Rd, Nong Kae, Hua Hin
venues.verdict: Beachside hotel restaurant with over 1,300 reviews — reliable Thai seafood with beautiful ocean views south of town.
venues.whatToOrder: Grilled squid, tom yum goong, and the seafood fried rice. Great breakfast too.
venues.insiderTip: South of central Hua Hin — less crowded and more relaxed. Opens early for breakfast.

venues.name: Jek Pia
venues.nameThai: เจ๊กเปี๊ยะ
venues.verdict: Legendary local noodle shop since the 1950s — the cheapest and most authentic seafood noodle experience in Hua Hin.
venues.whatToOrder: The fish ball noodle soup (kuay teow) — it's what everyone comes for. Simple, fresh, perfect.
venues.insiderTip: Opens at 6 AM and closes by noon — this is a morning/brunch spot only. Come hungry, eat early.

venues.name: Sungwean Seafood
venues.nameThai: สังวาลย์ซีฟู้ด
venues.verdict: The Reddit sleeper pick — a no-foreigner, all-Thai seafood joint near Cha-am that locals swear by.
venues.whatToOrder: Whatever's freshest that day — ask the staff. The fried whole fish and crab dishes are consistently praised.
venues.insiderTip: Closer to Cha-am than Hua Hin, but the detour is worth it. Zero English menu — use Google Translate or point.

venues.name: Chaolay Seafood
venues.verdict: The iconic Hua Hin seafood institution on Naresdamri pier — 3,000+ reviews and decades of history. The most well-known name in town.
venues.whatToOrder: Steamed crab, garlic prawns, papaya salad, and the whole fried fish. Classic Thai seafood done right.
venues.insiderTip: Very popular with both locals and tourists — go early (before 6 PM) or expect a wait. The pier tables have the best views.

venues.name: KO Seafood
venues.nameThai: โก ซีฟู้ด
venues.verdict: The go-to seafood spot at Hua Hin Night Market — pick your catch, choose your cooking style, and watch it grilled fresh.
venues.whatToOrder: Pick your own seafood from the display — grilled tiger prawns, steamed mussels, and fried squid are the hits.
venues.insiderTip: It's at the end of the night market — perfect as your main course after browsing the stalls.
